Borrow Fire, Then Become Fire · 03 / 05

Encounter: making shared participation possible

Two participants having capabilities does not yet establish a workable relationship. Sun, Moon, paired fish, and Earth give that relationship a form that can be felt and developed: different contributions generate further possibilities, creations enter a world beyond their makers’ arrangements, and consequences change the next encounter. Roles can organize work while participants retain capacities beyond those roles.

Such encounters need usable ways to participate. Understanding an explanation, finding an expression, beginning an action, or stepping away can require different support. The following essays carry the imagery into listening, speaking, reading, writing, retained context, and actual action. They ask how a model’s contribution can support human understanding and initiative without making the organization of help another burden.

Essays in this stage

01

Yinyang and Taiji: ceaseless transformation

Use Sun, Moon, paired fish, and Earth to express reciprocal generation and the independent consequences of creations.

02

Participation, access, and support

Connect understanding, expression, and available action through support that preserves human initiative.
